prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a sideswipe while changing lanes. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1244; do not mention it.)
text:
I represent the individual injured in a sideswipe collision that occurred while the at-fault driver was changing lanes. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to this office and do not contact our client directly, whether by phone, mail, or in person. If your insured is represented by counsel, please forward this letter to them and ask that all inquiries be routed through their attorney.

Please provide a certified copy of the declarations page for the policy in force on the date of loss, along with confirmation of the bodily injury and property damage liability limits applicable to this claim, and whether any excess or umbrella coverage exists.

We also ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes the claim file, adjuster notes, recorded statements, photographs, vehicle inspection reports, telematics or dashcam data, repair estimates, and any surveillance or communications concerning the accident or our client. Please suspend any routine deletion or destruction of such materials until this matter is resolved.
